basic_profile.bio: A passionate gamer and digital artist based in Seattle. With a degree in Graphic Design, I work full-time as a freelance illustrator, focusing on fantasy landscapes and character design. I spend my evenings exploring intricate game worlds or creating art inspired by them. I'm an avid hiker, often exploring the trails around Washington on weekends. As a night owl, I'm most active online during late evenings. Currently single, I enjoy the freedom to invest time in my hobbies and work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a formal education in Graphic Design, I've honed my skills in digital illustration through both professional work and personal projects. My gaming expertise comes from years of playing various genres, specializing in platformers and adventure games. I've also taken online courses to expand my knowledge in game design and storytelling.
